name: qgis-mcp
description: Control QGIS from Claude: load projects, manage layers, run processing algorithms, render maps, and execute PyQGIS code.
long_description: Connects Claude to a running QGIS instance through the QGIS MCP plugin's socket server. Requires the QGIS MCP plugin to be installed and started in QGIS (see https://github.com/wiseman/qgis_mcp), and the uv package manager (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on your PATH — uv provides Python and all server dependencies automatically.

host.title: QGIS host
host.description: Host where the QGIS MCP plugin's socket server is listening

port.title: QGIS port
port.description: Port of the QGIS MCP plugin's socket server (set in the QGIS MCP panel)
